name: dev.lookupkit/lookup-kit
title: Lookup Kit
description: 87 pay-per-call lookup tools for agents: validation, DNS, SSL, web to Markdown, weather, maths.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: x402 payment test, health check, ping. The first call to try. Costs $0.001 and returns pong, the server time and the service version, proving your x402 payment setup works with this service before you call the other tools. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: phone_check
tools.description: Phone number validation, phone number lookup and formatting API. Check whether a phone number is valid and get it in standard formats (E.164, international, national), its country and line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free...). Works offline with Google's libphonenumber rules; the number is not called, stored or logged. Send country (2 letters) when the number has no + prefix. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: IBAN validation, IBAN checker and parser. Check an IBAN (international bank account number): valid checksum and length for its country, country code, bank code and account parts, and the printable format. Format check only, it does not contact any bank. Nothing is stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: vat_format_check
tools.description: VAT number validation, EU VAT number format checker. Check whether a VAT number has the right format for its country (all EU countries, Northern Ireland XI, UK GB, Switzerland CHE, Norway NO). Format only: it does not confirm the business is registered. Send it with the country prefix, e.g. DE123456789. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: luhn_check
tools.description: Credit card number validation (Luhn check), card brand detection, IMEI check. Run the Luhn checksum on a number (payment card, IMEI, many ID numbers). For card-like numbers also names the likely card brand. Format check only: it does not say the card exists or works. The number is never stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: isbn_ean_check
tools.description: ISBN validation, barcode check (EAN, UPC, GTIN), ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 converter. Validate an ISBN-10, ISBN-13, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A or GTIN-14 check digit, say which kind it is, and convert ISBN-10 to ISBN-13. Offline, nothing stored. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: random_number
tools.description: Random number generator, true random integers in a range. Fair random whole numbers between min and max (inclusive), from a cryptographic random source. count up to 100. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description: Coin flip, heads or tails, random coin toss. Flip a fair coin (cryptographic random). count up to 100 flips; returns each result and the totals. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: dice_roll
tools.description: Dice roller, roll dice (d20, 2d6), random dice for games. Roll dice in standard notation such as 2d6, 1d20+5 or 4d6-1 (up to 100 dice, up to 1000 sides). Returns each die and the total. Cryptographic random. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: random_pick
tools.description: Random picker, choose a random item or winner from a list. Pick one or more items at random from a list (comma or newline separated), without repeats. Cryptographic random. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: shuffle
tools.description: Shuffle a list, randomize order. Shuffle a list into a fair random order (comma or newline separated, up to 1000 items). Cryptographic random. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: password_generate
tools.description: Password generator, generate a strong secure random password. Generate random passwords (8 to 128 characters) from a cryptographic random source, with or without symbols and look-alike characters, and the strength in bits. Generated on the fly, never stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: local_time
tools.description: Current time in any time zone, world clock, timezone lookup. The current date and time in any IANA time zone (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo): local date, time, weekday, UTC offset, abbreviation and whether daylight saving is on. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Time zone converter, convert time between timezones. Convert a local date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM) from one IANA time zone to another, with daylight saving handled. E.g. a 3pm meeting in New York in Berlin time. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: days_between
tools.description: Date difference calculator, days between two dates. Days between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD), plus weeks, and the difference in years, months and days. Negative if end is before start. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: date_add
tools.description: Date calculator, add or subtract days, weeks, months or years to a date. Add (or subtract, with negative numbers) days, weeks, months and years to a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Month ends are handled (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Business days calculator, working days between dates. Count business days (Monday to Friday) between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD), counting the start date and not the end date, or add business days to a date. Weekends only: public holidays are not taken off. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: unix_time
tools.description: Unix timestamp converter, epoch time to date and date to epoch. Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) to a date, or a date (ISO 8601) to a Unix timestamp. With no input, returns the current Unix time. Optional zone shows the local time too. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: cron_explain
tools.description: Cron expression explainer and parser, next cron run times. Explain a cron expression in plain English (5 or 6 fields, e.g. '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5') and list its next run times in a time zone (default UTC). Says when the expression is invalid. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: distance
tools.description: Distance calculator between coordinates, haversine distance (km, miles). Great-circle distance between two points given as latitude and longitude (decimal degrees): kilometres, miles, nautical miles, plus the starting compass bearing and the midpoint. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Unit conversion, unit converter (metric, imperial, temperature, cooking). Convert between units of length, weight, volume (including cooking cups and spoons), area, speed, time, data size, pressure, energy and temperature. E.g. value=5&from=mi&to=km, or 100 f to c. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: math_eval
tools.description: Calculator, math expression evaluator with exact decimal arithmetic. Evaluate a maths expression exactly with decimal arithmetic (0.1+0.2 = 0.3): + - * / ^ %, brackets, sqrt, abs, round(x, places), floor, ceil, ln, log, exp, sin, cos, tan, min, max, mod, pi, e. A safe parser: no code is run. Input: expr. Output: result (string, exact), number. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Statistics calculator: mean, median, mode, standard deviation, quartiles. Statistics for a list of numbers (comma or space separated, up to 10,000): count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, range, sample and population standard deviation and variance, quartiles. Exact decimal arithmetic. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: percentage
tools.description: Percentage calculator, percent change, discount and tax. Percentages, exactly: what is P% of X (mode=of), X is what % of Y (mode=is_what), % change from X to Y (mode=change), add or remove P% to X (mode=add, remove, e.g. tax or discount). Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: loan_payment
tools.description: Loan calculator, mortgage payment calculator, amortization. Regular payment for a fixed-rate loan or mortgage: principal, annual interest rate (%), term in years or months, payments per year (12 = monthly). Returns the payment, total paid, total interest and the first and last schedule rows. Exact decimal maths. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Compound interest calculator, savings and investment growth. Future value with compound interest: starting amount, annual rate (%), years, compounding per year, optional regular contribution per period (added at the end of each period). Returns final balance, total contributed and interest earned, with a year-by-year table. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: token_count
tools.description: Token counter, count LLM tokens (GPT, OpenAI tokenizer), context window check. Count tokens in a text with an offline tokenizer: OpenAI's o200k_base (the encoding of GPT-4o, GPT-4.1 and o-series models). Counts for other model families (Claude, Gemini, Llama) are estimates. Optionally checks whether it fits a limit. The text is not stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: text_split
tools.description: Text chunking, text splitter for RAG and embeddings. Split text into chunks of at most size characters for search indexes or LLM context (RAG), with optional overlap, keeping paragraph, sentence or word boundaries where possible. Returns each chunk with its start and end position. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: injection_check
tools.description: Prompt injection detection, scan untrusted text before an AI agent reads it. Scan text (a web page, email, document or tool output) for known prompt-injection patterns before giving it to an AI agent: instruction overrides, fake system tags, jailbreak phrases, data-exfiltration and payment instructions, hidden characters. Returns a 0-100 risk score, a level and each matched pattern. It is a rule-based pattern check and CAN MISS attacks; it is not a guarantee of safety. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: pii_redact
tools.description: PII detection and redaction, remove personal data and secrets from text. Find and redact personal and secret data in text by pattern: email addresses, phone numbers, payment card numbers (Luhn-checked), IBANs, US SSNs, IP addresses, API keys and tokens, and passwords in URLs. Returns the redacted text and what was found (types and positions, not the values). Pattern-based: it can miss things, and it does not detect names or street addresses. Runs in memory only; the text is never stored or logged. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC check, email deliverability and email security grade. Grade a domain's email security A to F: SPF record and its policy, DMARC record and policy, DKIM keys at 26 common selectors, MX records and MTA-STS, with a plain list of issues to fix. Tells you whether mail from the domain is easy to spoof. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Security headers check, website security scan and grade (HSTS, CSP). Grade a website's HTTP security A to F: HTTPS and the http-to-https redirect, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and exposed software versions, with a plain list of issues. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Word counter, character count and reading time. Count characters (with and without spaces), words, sentences, paragraphs and lines in a text, with reading and speaking time and the most common words. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: Slug generator, slugify text, URL slug from a title. Turn a title into a clean URL slug: lowercase, accents removed, spaces to dashes (or underscores), punctuation dropped. E.g. 'Café Menu: Spring 2026!' becomes 'cafe-menu-spring-2026'. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: JSON validator and formatter, pretty-print or minify JSON. Check whether text is valid JSON; if it is, return it pretty-printed (or minified) with its top-level type and size; if not, return the error and where it is. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: CSV to JSON converter, parse CSV. Convert CSV text to JSON: an array of objects using the header row (or arrays when header=false). Handles quoted fields, commas and new lines inside quotes; delimiter auto-detected (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe) or set. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: markdown_to_html
tools.description: Markdown to HTML converter, render Markdown. Convert Markdown (GitHub style: headings, lists, links, code blocks, tables) to HTML. Raw HTML in the input is escaped for safety. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: html_to_text
tools.description: HTML to text, HTML to Markdown converter, strip HTML tags. Strip HTML down to readable plain text (scripts and styles removed, entities decoded, paragraphs kept), or convert it to Markdown with format=markdown. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Base64 encode and decode, Base64 converter. Encode text to Base64 (standard or URL-safe), or decode Base64 back to text (UTF-8). mode=encode or decode. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Hash generator: SHA-256, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-512 and HMAC. Hash text with SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-384, SHA-512 or MD5 (hex and Base64), or an HMAC with a key. Nothing is stored or logged. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: uuid
tools.description: UUID generator, generate UUID v4 or v7 (GUID). Generate UUIDs: version 4 (random) or version 7 (time-ordered, good for database keys). count up to 100. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Text diff, compare two texts and find the differences. Compare two texts and return what was added and removed, by line or by word, with a unified-style summary and a similarity score. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: regex_test
tools.description: Regex tester, test a regular expression and see matches. Test a JavaScript regular expression against a text: whether it matches, every match with its position and capture groups, and an optional replacement result. Send the pattern without slashes and flags separately (e.g. gi). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Language detection, detect what language a text is in. Detect which language a text is written in (about 80 major languages), with the ISO 639-3 code, the language name and the top alternatives. Works offline; best with a sentence or more. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: QR code generator, create a QR code for a URL or text (SVG). Make a QR code for any text or link. Returns an SVG image (as text and as a data: URL ready for an tag), with error-correction level L, M, Q or H. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: country_info
tools.description: Country information API: capital, currency, languages, calling code, flag. Facts about a country from its name or ISO code (2 or 3 letters): official name, capital, region, area, languages, currencies, calling code, internet domain, neighbouring countries, flag emoji, coordinates, landlocked and UN membership. Data: mledoze/countries (ODbL). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description: JWT decoder, decode a JSON Web Token and check expiry. Decode a JSON Web Token: header, payload (claims) and readable issued, not-before and expiry times, and whether it has expired. Decode only: the signature is NOT verified, so do not trust the claims for security decisions. Tokens are never stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: semver_compare
tools.description: Semver compare, version comparison and range check (npm semver). Compare two semantic versions (e.g. 1.2.3 vs 1.10.0-beta.1), check whether a version satisfies a range (^1.2, ~2.0, >=3 <4), or get the newest version from a list that satisfies a range. Uses npm's semver rules. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: cidr_calc
tools.description: Subnet calculator, CIDR calculator, IP range for IPv4 and IPv6. Subnet calculator for IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24): network and broadcast addresses, first and last usable host, netmask, wildcard, number of addresses, and whether an optional IP is inside the block. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: format_convert
tools.description: YAML to JSON, JSON to YAML and CSV converter. Convert data between YAML, JSON and CSV (from and to). CSV input needs a header row; CSV output needs a list of objects. Returns the converted text, or the parse error with its position. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: http_status
tools.description: HTTP status code lookup, what an HTTP error code means. What an HTTP status code means (e.g. 429, 502, 526), in plain words, with its class and whether to retry. Includes standard codes and Cloudflare's 52x codes. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: mime_type
tools.description: MIME type lookup, content type for a file extension. The MIME type for a file name or extension (report.pdf -> application/pdf), or the usual extension for a MIME type (image/webp -> webp). Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS lookup, DNS records (A, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) for any domain. Look up DNS records for a domain: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV or all the common ones at once (type=ALL). Uses Cloudflare's public 1.1.1.1 resolver over HTTPS. Returns each record with its TTL. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Email validation, email verification, disposable email check. Check an email address without sending anything: is the format valid, does the domain exist and accept mail (MX records), is it a known throwaway/disposable provider, is it a role address (info@, admin@...) or a free webmail provider. The address is not stored or logged, and no email is ever sent. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: rdap_domain
tools.description: WHOIS domain lookup (RDAP), domain expiry date, domain age, registrar. Registration details for a domain from the official RDAP registry (the modern WHOIS): registrar, created, updated and expiry dates, status codes, name servers, DNSSEC, and the registrar's abuse contact. Personal contact details are left out. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: url_check
tools.description: URL checker, website uptime and broken link check, redirect checker. Check a URL: final HTTP status, every redirect hop, time to answer, content type and size, server and caching headers. Tells you if a link is up, broken or redirecting. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: robots_check
tools.description: robots.txt checker, can a crawler fetch this URL. Read a site's robots.txt and say whether a crawler (user_agent, default *) may fetch a given URL or path, which rule decided it, the crawl delay and the sitemaps listed. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Web page to Markdown, scrape a website to clean LLM-ready text. Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (navigation, scripts and footers removed), with the title. Plain fetch, no JavaScript rendering. Obeys the site's robots.txt. Long pages are cut at max_chars. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Website metadata scraper: SEO tags, Open Graph, links extractor. Fetch a public web page and return its SEO and sharing metadata (title, description, canonical, language, Open Graph, Twitter card, favicon, robots meta, headings) and its links (internal and external, up to 300). Obeys the site's robots.txt. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: sitemap_parse
tools.description: Sitemap parser, get all URLs from a website's sitemap.xml. Read an XML sitemap (or a site's robots.txt-listed sitemap when you send just the domain) and return its URLs with last-modified dates, or the child sitemaps of a sitemap index. Up to 1000 entries; .gz sitemaps supported. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: rss_to_json
tools.description: RSS to JSON, RSS and Atom feed reader and parser. Read an RSS, Atom or RDF feed and return it as clean JSON: feed title, link and description, then each item's title, link, date, author, summary (plain text) and categories. Up to 100 items. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: currency_convert
tools.description: Currency converter, exchange rates (USD, EUR, GBP and 30 more). Convert an amount between about 30 major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, CNY, INR...) using the European Central Bank's daily reference rates, for the latest working day or a date in the last 90 days. Reference rates, not trading prices. Source: ECB. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: wikipedia_summary
tools.description: Wikipedia summary API, look up any topic on Wikipedia. The opening summary of a Wikipedia article for a topic (any language edition, default English): title, short description, summary text, image and link. Finds the best matching article if the title is not exact. Text is CC BY-SA 4.0: credit Wikipedia and link the article. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Weather forecast API, current weather by city name or coordinates, worldwide. Current weather and forecast for any city (e.g. city=London or city=Portland, OR) or any latitude and longitude: temperature, feels, wind, humidity, precipitation and conditions now, the next 12 hours, and daily highs, lows and rain for up to 9 days. Worldwide from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0); source=nws uses the US National Weather Service for US locations. Metric with US units added. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: recalls
tools.description: Product recall search: FDA food and drug recalls, car recalls (NHTSA), CPSC. Search official US recalls: food, drugs and medical devices (FDA enforcement reports via openFDA), consumer products (CPSC) or vehicles (NHTSA, by make, model and year). Returns the newest matches with date, product, reason, company, class and status. Public US government data. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: package_info
tools.description: npm, PyPI and crates.io package lookup: latest version, licence, downloads. Facts about an open-source package on npm, PyPI or crates.io: latest version, description, licence, homepage and repository, release date, dependency count and recent downloads. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: vulnerabilities
tools.description: Vulnerability scanner for packages, CVE lookup (OSV), dependency security check. Known security vulnerabilities for an open-source package, optionally at a specific version, from the OSV.dev database (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist...): ID, CVE aliases, summary, severity, published date and fixed versions. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: GitHub repo stats: stars, forks, issues, latest release. Public stats for a GitHub repository (owner/repo): stars, forks, open issues, watchers, main language, licence, topics, created and last pushed dates, archived flag and the latest release. Cached for an hour. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: arXiv search, find research papers and academic papers. Search arXiv for research papers by keywords, title, author or category (e.g. cs.AI): title, authors, abstract, categories, dates, and the abstract and PDF links, newest or most relevant first. Metadata from arXiv (CC0). Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: ip_location
tools.description: IP geolocation, IP address lookup (country, city, coordinates). Approximate location of an IPv4 or IPv6 address: country, region, city and coordinates (city-level accuracy, not a street address). Offline lookup in DB-IP's IP to City Lite database; the IP is not stored or logged. IP Geolocation by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: postal_code
tools.description: ZIP code lookup, postal code to city, state and coordinates. Look up a postal or ZIP code in about 120 countries: place names, state or province, county and coordinates. Send country (2 letters) and code; for the UK, Canada and the Netherlands only the first part of the code (outward code, FSA) is covered. Data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: SSL certificate checker, TLS certificate expiry and issuer. Check a website's SSL/TLS certificate: whether browsers trust it, who issued it, valid from and to, days until it expires, the names it covers, key type and size, signature algorithm, SHA-256 fingerprint and the chain. Port 443 by default. Sites served through Cloudflare cannot be inspected; those calls fail and are not charged. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: airport
tools.description: Airport lookup by IATA or ICAO code, nearest airports. Find airports by IATA or ICAO code (YVR, CYVR), by name or city, or the nearest ones to a latitude and longitude: name, city, country, region, coordinates, elevation, size and whether it has scheduled flights. 11,000+ airports from OurAirports (public domain). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: sun_moon
tools.description: Sunrise and sunset times, golden hour and moon phase. Sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, solar noon, golden hour and day length for any latitude, longitude and date, plus the moon phase, illumination, moonrise and moonset. Computed, no outside source. Times in UTC, or local with zone (IANA, e.g. Europe/Paris). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: us_inflation
tools.description: Inflation calculator, CPI inflation adjustment for US dollars. Adjust a US dollar amount for inflation between two months or years with the official CPI-U (all items, US city average) from the Bureau of Labor Statistics: the equivalent amount, cumulative inflation %, the CPI values used and the latest 12-month inflation rate. Public US government data. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: drug_label
tools.description: Drug information, FDA drug label lookup (uses, warnings, dosage). The official FDA drug label for a medicine by brand or generic name (openFDA): purpose, indications, active ingredients, warnings, do-not-use, dosage and directions, as published on the label. Label text only, NOT medical advice; openFDA data is not validated for clinical use. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: treasury_yields
tools.description: Treasury yields, US yield curve and interest rates. Daily US Treasury par yield curve rates (1 month to 30 years) from the US Treasury, for the latest business day or a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), with the 10y-2y spread. Public US government data. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: wayback
tools.description: Wayback Machine lookup, archived version of a web page. Whether a web page is archived in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, and the link and date of the snapshot closest to an optional date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for dead links and old versions of pages. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: define
tools.description: Dictionary API, English word definitions and meanings. English dictionary definitions of a word or phrase, grouped by part of speech, with an example sentence and synonyms for each sense. Finds base forms (running -> run). From Open English WordNet (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: synonyms
tools.description: Synonyms finder, thesaurus. Synonyms for an English word, grouped by meaning (each group with a short definition), from Open English WordNet (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: spell_check
tools.description: Spell checker, English spelling correction suggestions. Check the spelling of English text (US and UK spellings, 274,000 words): each unknown word with its position and up to 5 suggestions. Capitalised words that are not at the start of a sentence are treated as names and skipped. Offline; the text is not stored or logged. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: number_to_words
tools.description: Number to words converter, spell out numbers and cheque amounts. Write a number in English words (1234 -> one thousand two hundred and thirty-four), as an ordinal (twenty-first), or as a cheque-style currency amount (one hundred and five dollars and 50/100). Up to quintillions; decimals read digit by digit. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: note_save
tools.description: Agent memory, scratchpad: save a short note between agent runs. Save a short text note (up to 2000 characters) and get back a hard-to-guess id to read it later with note_read, e.g. to hand context between agent runs. Notes are deleted automatically after ttl_days (1 to 7, default 7). No listing or search: only someone with the id can read it. Do not store secrets or personal data. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: note_read
tools.description: Agent memory: read a saved note. Read a note saved with note_save, by its id. Returns the text and when it expires. Expired or unknown ids are not charged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: check_contact
tools.description: Contact verification, lead validation: email and phone check in one call. One call to vet a contact: email_check (format, MX, throwaway, role address), phone_check (valid, type, country) and email_security for the email's domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC grade). Send email and/or phone. Nothing is stored or logged. Price: $0.006 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Website audit: uptime, SSL, security headers, domain age in one call. One call to audit a website: url_check (status, redirects, speed), ssl_check (certificate, expiry), security_headers (A-F grade), rdap_domain (registration and expiry dates, so domain age) and robots_check. Each part is returned under its tool name. Price: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Domain lookup: DNS, WHOIS and email security (SPF, DMARC) in one call. One call to profile a domain: dns_lookup (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME), rdap_domain (registrar, created and expiry dates, status) and email_security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC grade). Price: $0.008 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
